# Security policy
Customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using AES-256. Security incidents should be reported to security@example.com.

# Refund policy v1
Refunds may be requested within 30 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

# Support policy
Support is available Monday through Friday. Priority customers receive a response within one business day.
